sql:
SELECT co.name AS empresa, p.status, count(DISTINCT p.id) AS parcelas, count(e.id) AS recebimentos_parciais, coalesce(sum(e.amount),0) AS valor_recebido_parcial
FROM event_payments p
JOIN companies co ON co.id = p.company_id
LEFT JOIN event_payment_entries e ON e.payment_id = p.id
WHERE p.status <> 'paid'
GROUP BY co.name, p.status
ORDER BY co.name, p.status
